title: Missing time on drive home from college
summary: Bob Maguire tells of Missing time on drive home from college, about Maguire's first month of college at road home from college, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: about 2 and 1 half hours into it suddenly we found oursel in the middle of nowhere didn't know where we were didn't know how we got there and eventually looking at our watch we figured out that somehow we had been asleep for an hour and a half so this was a classic example of missing time

plain: Bob Maguire, described as a former contractor for the CIA, the US foreign intelligence agency, says that in his first month of college he was driving home with others. About two and a half hours into the trip, he says, they suddenly found themselves in the middle of nowhere with no idea how they got there, and their watches showed an hour and a half had gone by. He calls it a classic case of "missing time", lost hours that some people link to encounters with beings from elsewhere.
